organic_results.title: No, UNESCO has not declared 'Jana Gana Mana' the best national anthem
organic_results.snippet: A viral WhatsApp message claims UNESCO declared the Indian national anthem the best in the world. UNESCO gives no such award; the claim has circulated since 2008 and has been repeatedly debunked.

organic_results.title: Fact check: UNESCO 'best national anthem' message is a recycled hoax
organic_results.snippet: BOOM found that UNESCO has never ranked national anthems. The organisation itself denied instituting any such award when the hoax first went viral.

organic_results.title: UNESCO | Building peace in the minds of men and women
organic_results.snippet: UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. It does not confer awards on national anthems.

organic_results.title: The 'best national anthem' forward is back — here's why it refuses to die
organic_results.snippet: The WebQoof team traces the UNESCO anthem hoax through a decade of WhatsApp virality.

organic_results.title: Proud moment for every Indian — UNESCO declares our anthem BEST!
organic_results.snippet: Share this great news with every Indian! Jana Gana Mana declared best anthem in the world by UNESCO.
